title: plugin-auth: no door mints a SCIM connection bearer (`mintScimConnectionCredential` has no caller and the object refuses create), so no IdP can connect
body:
repo:cloud#3 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2

Filing gate: **(b) a contract gap with a named consumer**, measured by the cloud#3667 dev on a real licensed objectos-ee serve (report on objectstack-ai/cloud#3667, Enterprise SCIM leaver lifecycle; draft PR objectstack-ai/cloud#3672). Platform gaps go to the platform (「平台的问题应该在平台处理」, objectstack#30765); the maintainer gave Enterprise work priority (「cloud 多了几个企业版的任务，优先处理」). Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#3667 (live Okta / Entra ID provisioning).

## 维护者速读

SCIM 自动开通需要一个连接令牌，IdP（Okta / Entra ID）要拿它来调用平台。平台里铸令牌的函数已经写好，但没有任何地方调用它，管理员也无法通过数据接口创建，所以现在没有人能拿到令牌，真实的 IdP 也就接不上。需要给管理员一个铸造（以及吊销）SCIM 连接令牌的入口。

## Measured (objectstack `6ddf827236`; cloud pin `2ffdb649` on the serve)

- `POST /api/v1/data/sys_scim_connection_credential` as the platform admin → `405 OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` (allowed: list, aggregate, export). The object declares the plugin-auth SCIM connection service its only writer.
- `git grep mintScimConnectionCredential` → defined at `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-connection-service.ts:164`, with no production caller and no export from `@objectstack/plugin-auth`'s entry.
- `auth-manager-plugin-list.ts:798` wires `verifyScimBearerToken` only (`connections: []`; the upstream `managedConnections` catalog is deliberately not adopted, ruling 2026-08-25).
- The cloud suite had to write the bearer straight into the store to run at all.

## Expected

- An admin-only door (route, action or Setup surface; the lane decides, and says why) that mints a connection bearer through `mintScimConnectionCredential`. The secret is shown once and never readable afterwards, as the service's header says. Revoking or rotating a connection goes through the same door.
- The mint and the revoke each write a `sys_audit_log` row naming the admin and the connection, never the secret.

## Acceptance

- Tests: an admin mints a bearer and a SCIM `POST /Users` with it answers 201; a non-admin is refused; a revoked bearer answers 401; the audit rows exist and carry no secret.

Suggested-grade: p1 · Enterprise priority (maintainer).

Dedupe (2026-11-06): `SCIM credential mint` → 35 hits, top 4 closed and unrelated (#8192 is at-rest posture); `mintScimConnectionCredential` → 4 hits, all closed (#14522 transactions, #14360 active:false). None covers this gap.
